Robinsons Land Corporation (RLC), has been awarded the Best Developer Southeast Asia by DOT property. This was recently announced, giving recognition to several property developers in Southeast Asia.
According to DOT Property Asia Southeast, over 25 awards were handed out.
RLC’s current residential portfolio includes over 70 residential buildings strategically located in major urban areas in the Philippines.
RLC was also recently honored as the Best Developer by Dot Property Philippines This is the second time that RLC has been recognized. This award commends RLC for its Robinsons Communities brand which develops affordable and quality condominium projects.
Developments by RLC under the Robinsons Communities brand are not only reasonably priced, but they also offer residents an enjoyable living experience. Robinsons Communities takes this promise to heart as it leads and works tirelessly to create affordable and high-quality condominiums while at the same time providing homeowners accessibility and lifestyle conveniences.
"Our objective is offering quality living experience at a reasonable price that is well received by the market.” Henry L. Yap, Business Unit General Manager, Robinsons Luxuria, Residences & Communities, explains.
Photo shows from L to R: Robinsons Communities Head of Sales, Mr. Ferdinand Adriano; Robinsons Luxuria Head of Sales and Marketing, Mr. Jose Leonardo Garcia; Arch.Henry L. Yap, Business Unit-General Manager Robinsons Communities, Residences and Luxuria; Tanya Peralta-Yu,Country Manager, DOT Property Co., Ltd; Robinsons Residences Head of Sales, Mr. Alexis Ojeda.
